paragraphs.text: Organizers are seeking vendors for the Christmas in Ecru bazaar, scheduled for 10 a.m.–2 p.m. Saturday, Dec. 5, at Blake Mounce Memorial Park, also known as Ecru Park, at 154 Central Ave. The announcement advertises 30 vendor places at $25 each.

Vendors should confirm the application deadline with organizers before making arrangements. The notice shared by the Town of Ecru says applications and payment are due Nov. 10, while the linked event’s description gives Nov. 2. The two published notices currently disagree.

The announcement directs prospective vendors to the Christmas in Ecru committee contacts listed in the original notice to request an application or ask questions. It says cash is accepted and checks should be payable to the Town of Ecru, but specifically instructs applicants not to take their paperwork or vendor fee to Town Hall.
The town’s shared notice and the original event listing are linked below so prospective vendors can read the instructions and contact organizers for confirmation.
